changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Match imported routes to their published file and retain route retry state.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE google_health.data_point ADD COLUMN route_file_modified_at timestamp with time zone, ADD COLUMN route_file_size bigint, ADD COLUMN route_next_retry_at timestamp with time zone; CREATE INDEX idx_google_health_route_retry ON google_health.data_point (connection_id, route_next_retry_at, id) WHERE data_type = 'exercise' AND route_state IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED', 'NO_LOCATION_SCOPE', 'NOT_APPLICABLE');
changeSet.rollback: ALTER TABLE google_health.data_point DROP COLUMN route_file_modified_at, DROP COLUMN route_file_size, DROP COLUMN route_next_retry_at;
